name: Depo Auto Parts Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Depo Auto Parts Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and other related lighting products in Taiwan, Asia, and the United States. The company offers stamping, plastic injections, and painting and other transportation equipment. It also engages in the manufactures and trades of automotive and motorcycle parts; automotive and motorcycle light fixtures and bulbs; automotive plastic parts; trades of auto parts; supplies automotive and automotive light equipment; automotive instrument clusters; car and signal lights; automotive parts and components; light products; research and development of automotive electronic devices; and other related products.
